This is a strong summary of what we’ve covered, but I’m not ready to call it the whole scope yet. A few important management needs are missing:

- I need to permanently delete a bookmark, clearly distinguished from reversible archiving.
- Editing should include the saved address itself, not only its title, summary, tags, and note.
- I need to select several bookmarks—or everything matching the current search/view—and add or remove tags, mark read or unread, archive, or delete them together.
- I’d like to save a useful combination of search terms and included or excluded tags as a reusable collection.
- The app should preserve a local copy of a page for later viewing; for a PDF, it should keep the PDF itself. Creating an Internet Archive copy should also be available.
- I need to import and export standard browser-bookmark HTML files, retaining titles, tags, and original dates.
- Settings should also cover things like font size and how many items are displayed.
- When collecting page details, include the real site icon and preview image where available.

Also, ordinary long titles, notes, and many tags wrapping cleanly is part of this build’s basic readability; performance work for genuinely large collections can remain later.

Please add these to the proposed scope before implementation begins.
